title: Watch the World Cup in Santa Monica
description:
Watch the World Cup in Santa Monica ⚽️

We've got you covered with watch parties and events throughout the tournament:

 📍Santa Monica Place Kickoff Celebration
June 12 | 11 a.m. - 9 p.m.

📍Michelob Ultra Pitchside Club at the Santa Monica Pier  (21+)
Daily, June 12 - 26 | 3 p.m. - 9 p.m.

📍 Third Street Promenade Golden Hour Series
June 12 - 27 & July 10 | 2 - 9 p.m

📍 World Play Zone at the Metro Downtown Santa Monica Station
 June 12 - 26 | Hours vary

📍 Coast Open Streets Festival & World Cup Final Watch Party
July 19 | 10 a.m. - 6 p.m. | Various locations 

Save this post and visit santamonica.gov for event details. 

See you there!
